title: QCB Security Under the BU Definition
summary: The BU definition permits success on a message not output by the forgery; proving QCB secure under this unknown-message condition remains open.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved problem is to prove security for QCB under the BU definition in which a successful forgery is evaluated using a message $M$ that need not be an output of the forgery, so an adversary may forge on an unknown message $M$; the available evidence conjectures that this definition is non-trivial for QCB, while noting that such a proof would likely be more technical than the original security proof.

scope.domain: Quantum-secure authenticated encryption and BU security for the QCB construction.
assumptions: The BU success condition is evaluated using a message M that need not be an output of the forgery.
parameters: M — the message used to evaluate forgery success, which may be unknown to the adversary
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove security for QCB under this BU definition.

progress.summary: The source conjectures that the BU definition is non-trivial for QCB and might be proven for it. It leaves the proof open and expects it to be more technical than the original security proof.
citation_labels: Ritam Bhaumik et al., QCB: Efficient Quantum-secure Authenticated Encryption
